scope: Annoksen laskennallinen makroarvio reseptin raaka-aineista. Yleiset koostumustiedot ovat Fineli Release 20 -poiminnasta.

ingredients.matchEvidence: Fineli Release 20 #324 PARSAKAALI, BROKKOLI. Ainesosan yleinen koostumus.
ingredients.edibleEvidence: Määrä kuvaa syötävää tai reseptissä käytettävää osaa.
ingredients.retentionEvidence: Laskennassa annoksiin jaetaan käytetty aines; haihtuva vesi ei muuta annoskohtaisia makroja.

ingredients.matchEvidence: FSANZ AFCD Release 3 F006465. Same flour type and dry input state. The dataset represents generic wholemeal pasta rather than a brand or pasta shape.

record.name: Pasta, wholemeal wheat flour, dry
record.licence: FSANZ AFCD Release 3; CC BY-SA 3.0 Australia; Australian data limitation applies
record.polyolsEvidence: AFCD paired available carbohydrate with and without its reported sugar alcohols. This is the dataset's difference, not a laboratory finding for the recipe product.

ingredients.edibleEvidence: The recorded dry pasta or grated cheese weight is already the edible quantity.
ingredients.retentionEvidence: Recipe divides the full input batch. This is an ingredient-input estimate with no claim of measured cooking loss.
